items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’ve been impressed the way Cuomo has been handling it.

ctx.x: I’m giving you all the hardball questions I have, Victor, I’ll do one more. How do you feel about the role of the either local or state or federal government since this pandemic started?

DeBlasio — I haven’t seen him — my only source is CNN you know. So maybe I have a biased view, I don’t know. DeBlasio hasn’t made too many announcements, I haven’t heard much from him from what I’ve seen. He seems to have blundered during the protests, you know, in controlling the city. I don’t know. Maybe it’s a hard situation, I don’t know. So I don’t want to make a judgement there. I’ve been very impressed the way Cuomo has been handling it. You know he goes on TV and he’ll have statistics and he’ll that about…
Human nature is very confounding sometimes.
